q_45367.question_text: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)
q_45367.reasoning:
# Analysis: NVIDIA Q2 FY2027 Forward Guidance

**(a) Time left until resolution:**
The Q2 FY2027 earnings report will be released on August 26, 2026. Today is August 16, 2026. This means resolution occurs in approximately **10 days**.

**(b) Most likely outcome and why:**

The research provides the actual forward guidance already announced: **$91.0 billion ±2%**.

This was officially announced on May 20, 2026, when NVIDIA released Q1 FY2027 results. The guidance explicitly states a range of $91.0B ± 2%, which translates to approximately $89.18B to $92.82B.

The key facts:
- Q1 FY2027 actual revenue: $81.6B (ended April 26, 2026)
- Q2 FY2027 forward guidance announced: $91.0B ± 2% (announced May 20, 2026)
- This represents ~12% sequential growth, which is reasonable given NVIDIA's trajectory
- The guidance was noted to exclude any Data Center compute revenue from China
- This guidance was well above the consensus estimate of $86.84B at the time, suggesting confidence in the outlook

Since we are now 10 days away from the earnings release (August 26, 2026), and the company has already provided official forward guidance, the most likely outcome is that they will reaffirm or provide guidance very close to the $91.0B figure they announced in May. Companies rarely dramatically change their forward guidance in the quarter immediately following when they issued it, absent major unexpected developments.

**(c) What would push the value lower?**

- Major macroeconomic shock or geopolitical event in the past 3 months (none apparent in current date context)
- Unexpected weakness in customer demand signals or order cancellations
- Additional China-related restrictions beyond what was already baked into the May guidance
- Competitive pressures or market share losses
- Supply chain disruptions

**(d) What would push the value higher?**

- Better-than-expected demand momentum through Q2
- Higher-than-anticipated ASPs (average selling prices) on H100/H200 products
- Acceleration in AI adoption across enterprise/cloud customers
- Surprise positive developments in China policy allowing more Data Center revenue than expected
- Mix shift toward higher-margin products

**(e) Base rate or historical reference values:**

The most directly relevant reference is **the actual guidance already provided: $91.0 billion ± 2%**, announced on May 20, 2026. This represents the company's own most recent formal estimate of what they will guide for Q2.

Given that:
1. The guidance was provided just 3 months before the actual earnings release
2. NVIDIA's track record of maintaining guidance accuracy (they guided $91.0B and that's what we're forecasting they will likely guide again)
3. The company excluded China revenue conservatively, leaving upside protection

The most probable outcome is that the forward guidance will be at or very near $91.0B.

---

**Probability Distribution Reasoning:**

The central estimate is $91.0B based on the explicit guidance provided. The range given (99.5B to 115.5B lower bound open) includes values well above what was previously guided.

- The 50th percentile should be at the company's already-announced guidance: **$91.0B**
- The 10th percentile reflects downside risk from unexpected weakness: **$88.0B** (roughly the lower bound of their ±2% range)
- The 90th percentile reflects upside from beat scenarios: **$94.5B** (above guidance but not dramatic)

The extreme bounds in the question range (99.5B-115.5B) represent much larger moves than are historically typical for sequential quarterly guidance changes, so estimates should stay well within the $88-95B range as most likely.

q_45367.research_text:
NVIDIA's forward guidance for Q2 FY2027 revenue is projected to be $91.0 billion, plus or minus 2%. This outlook, announced on May 20, 2026, alongside their Q1 FY2027 earnings, does not assume any Data Center compute revenue from China [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm), [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027.html). This figure is well above the average quarterly revenue estimate of $86.84 billion, according to LSEG [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027.html).

For Q1 FY2027, which ended April 26, 2026, NVIDIA reported record revenue of $81.6 billion, an 85% increase year-over-year [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm). The Q2 FY2027 earnings report is expected to be released on Wednesday, August 26, 2026 [nvidianews.nvidia.com](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-sets-conference-call-for-second-quarter-financial-results-6927195).
